reason: I already delete settlement notice emails as spam, and a free-during-beta site that wants an account so I can go file somewhere else is the same pitch. I'm not giving a startup my identity to browse listings they admit aren't even verified.
objection: I don't want a startup storing my identity details — that's the whole reason these 'free money' sites exist, and I assume they're scams until proven otherwise.
would_change_my_mind: If I could browse and open the official administrator's claim form with no account and no personal information stored by you.
